title: Anne Rice’s Vampire Series Is Renewed as ‘Queen of the Damned’ for Season 4 - CNET
summary: Hot on the heels of the season three finale, AMC has announced the fourth season of Anne Rice’s Interview With the Vampire. Moscovitch will serve as showrunner for Queen of the Damned, with Johnson and Rolin Jones executive producing.
